events.headline: Henry Schein Raises 2026 Earnings Outlook as Q3 Profit Beats Forecasts and Dental Sales Grow

lifecycle.authority: Retained structured Lifecycle authority; Markdown and SQLite not read

providers.reason: Henry Schein delivered a significant 14.7% earnings beat and raised its full-year EPS guidance to $5.50–$5.56. Despite a slight revenue miss triggering a premarket dip, the 8.6% jump in US dental merchandise sales and a $125 million value-creation target by year-end provide a compelling 'buy the dip' opportunity based on margin expansion.
providers.risk: Transitioning CFO leadership and potential continued softness in discretionary orthodontic procedures.

providers.reason: Raised FY26 non-GAAP EPS to $5.50–5.56 from $5.29–5.39, a second straight raise, with adjusted EPS +19% and US dental merchandise +8.6%. Shares fell ~4% to $83, below the Q3 buyback average of $86.67, setting up a mean-reversion bounce.
providers.risk: Much of the beat came from a $0.19 tariff refund, revenue slightly missed, and a new CFO starts Nov 4; investors may keep discounting earnings quality.
